beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: London makes the week visible as a relay among institutional schedule, temporary room, camera, platform, labor, commerce and archive. This chapter follows circulation: A public stream can widen technical access while ranking systems, language, bandwidth and platform ownership continue to govern attention.
beats.onScreen: Then: In June 2020 the BFC launched a freely accessible digital hub; by September it described 50 digital-only activations and 21 combined physical-and-digital activations carrying films, podcasts, conversations, articles, and galleries.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: In June 2020 the BFC launched a freely accessible digital hub; by September it described 50 digital-only activations and 21 combined physical-and-digital activations carrying films, podcasts, conversations, articles, and galleries. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: The 2026 public schedule still separates physical and digital events, current designer criteria require moving content for digital activations, and the February 2026 programme advertised 19 digital activations plus a shared viewing lounge. Circulation is therefore programmed through both the interface and physical gathering spaces.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: The bounded search in G-FUTURE-07 did not verify a current named platform pilot with participants, owner, and delivery horizon.
